name: tracker-spoke-sync
goal: Prove durable Tracker spoke push and pull against pinned legacy wire behavior, including lost receipts, database identity replacement and isolated hub/peer cursors.

evidence: Pinned 122e190 wire handler and PR #140 signer. Declare push drain and retry, pull commit and retry, hub identity replay, stale response rejection, and independent hub/peer cursor states. All tests use in-memory synthetic state without listeners; vendor SQLite journal and scheduling stay with parent.
